observations: New v003 follows the direct fairy-pitta prop reference with a short rounded body, one warm-brown dot eye, broad flat wing colors, simple short feet and gentle paper grain.

Compared at the same250px registered-body height on pale and dark backgrounds: four separated breast V marks, four head/neck flecks and two main folded-wing color areas remove the dense feather-row/spot clutter of v001.

Moderately long down-curved bill, pale eyebrow and buff/cream palette preserve the intended curlew identity at stylized species granularity; legs are deliberately shortened for the accepted prop pattern.
